title: Efficiency under a Shared Additive Survival Effect across Right-Censored and Current-Status Sources
banked_reason: D0.5.G incremental (ceiling 6.2 < field gate 7.4), not salvageable in scope; math panel REVISE remains unresolved
gap_reasons: D0.5.G tier=incremental < floor=field (target=field) and NOT salvageable in scope
paper_score_ceiling 6.2 < 7.4; graded tier incremental, field capped at incremental
proof_attempt_summary: Derived the coupled mixed-censor normal operator, residual certificate, strict-gain witness, and an attainment argument for each fixed known smoothness exponent beta > 1/2. D0.5.G assessed the result as incremental, below the operator's field floor; a bounded revision cannot raise it to field. The math panel returned REVISE on two hypotheses/dependencies and one positioning point, all unrepaired at banking.
tldr: A full-data randomized-treatment law induces an iid observed mixture in which one source reports right-censored event times and the other reports current status. Under source-aligned potential-event laws and a prespecified shared additive survival effect across two strata, the canonical gradient is the solution of an explicit coupled three-coordinate normal operator rather than four independent scalar inversions. For every fixed known Hölder exponent \(\beta\in(1/2,2]\), a total restriction-preserving finite-sieve pilot and residual-certified coupled Galerkin solve achieve nuisance rate \( (\log n/n)^{\beta/(2\beta+1)} \), uniform fitted-score stability over the fixed class, a deterministic score-moment envelope, and cross-fitted studentized root-\(n\) inference attaining the restricted efficiency bound. For \(1/2<\beta\leq1\), the legal comparison sieve uses common nodal piecewise-linear survival and censoring fits and cell-average inspection-density fits. At \(\beta=1/2\), logarithmic factors prevent this first-order construction's product remainders from vanishing; this is not an impossibility claim for other estimators.
gap: Li and Li solve a scalar mixed-censor efficiency equation for one aligned event law and identify treatment contrasts as a future direction. Generic restriction projections do not compute the latent-survival block operator, its interval interface conditions, or a strict-gain frontier. Existing cross-fitted causal-survival theory treats right censoring rather than an estimated restriction-coupled mixed-censor operator.
fill: Derive the four-cell information form and its three-component normal equation with the exact restricted load and flux jump, certify numerical inversion by a computable residual, characterize exactly when the restriction lowers the bound, implement the frontier with observable coefficients, uniform mesh refinement, and a certified tolerance decision, prove strictness on a smooth full-support law, and isolate the projection-and-solver stability lemma required for feasible efficient inference.
